This seems more closely related, unfortunately it requires an R parser for BSON, which doesn't exisit AFAIK.

On Thursday, November 8, 2012 11:48:40 AM UTC-8, Brock Tibert wrote:
Is it possible to leverage RHadoop against data that is stored in MongoDB.  I see here that there is a connector, but I am not sure if these packages will allow me to embrace this format.  

If not, what is the best way to get my data into Hadoop so I can analyze it with R?  

This is probably best asked to the mongoDB folks. rmr understand typedbytes and Json as two language agnostic formats

 
Will the packages that are contained under the RHadoop umbrella allow me to both move and analyze my data?

Not move from mongoDB.
 
 For context, I also have the data stored in over 700 text files, which represent hourly data collected from Twitter.  Each file stores the pure JSON responses.

Simply stated, I am looking to analyze big data in R and these packages seem like a great place to start, however I am just a tad confused on how to take my data and move it between R and it's storage location.

Yes this question confuses me too. Take a look at the Tutorial or the step by step guide in the Learning Resource page on the wiki and see if there is any relation to your case. Best of all, get a hold of Ed kohwley Strata tutorial. It's all about processing twitter data. The code is linked to from the same page, the video is not yet available and will probably be for sale sometime later.
 

Antonio


Sorry for the novice question, but any help will be greatly appreciated.
